about: Course syllabus for the 9 AM and 7:30 PM reels, taught in order. Levels: B basic, I intermediate, A advanced. Sections 1-2 were not provided (course starts at section 3).

lessons.title: DDIC basics
points: Role of DDIC, SE11, activation, runtime objects (nametab)

lessons.title: Domains & data elements
points: Domain: data type, length, value range, fixed values, value table, conversion routine
Data element: field labels, documentation, search help & parameter ID assignment

lessons.title: Tables
points: Transparent, pooled, cluster tables (and their S/4HANA status)
Delivery class (A, C, L, G, E, S, W), data class, size category
Technical settings, buffering (single, generic, full), logging
Primary key, foreign keys, check tables, cardinality
Include structures and append structures; currency/quantity reference fields

lessons.title: Structures & table types
points: Flat, nested and deep structures; table type with key definition

lessons.title: Views
points: Database, projection, maintenance, help views
Maintenance view + table maintenance generator (SE54, SM30, SM34 view clusters)

lessons.title: Search helps
points: Elementary vs collective, selection method, dialog types, search help exits

lessons.title: Lock objects
points: Lock modes (E, S, X, O), generated ENQUEUE_/DEQUEUE_ function modules, SM12

lessons.title: Indexes
points: Primary vs secondary indexes, when to create, unique index

lessons.title: Type groups & enhancement categories
points: Type pools, enhancement category for append/include extensibility

lessons.title: Database utility
points: SE14 adjust/convert, table conversion after structural change

lessons.title: Concepts
points: Work area vs header line (obsolete), line type, table key, table kind

lessons.title: Table kinds
points: Standard, sorted, hashed; when to use each; access cost (linear, binary, hash)
Unique vs non-unique keys; default key pitfalls

lessons.title: Filling tables
points: APPEND, INSERT, COLLECT, APPEND LINES OF, SELECT ... INTO TABLE

lessons.title: Reading & looping
points: READ TABLE ... WITH KEY / INDEX / BINARY SEARCH, TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
LOOP AT ... WHERE, ASSIGNING <fs>, REFERENCE INTO

lessons.title: Changing & deleting
points: MODIFY, MODIFY ... TRANSPORTING, DELETE ... WHERE, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES
SORT, CLEAR, REFRESH, FREE (memory differences)

lessons.title: Control-level processing
points: AT FIRST / AT NEW / AT END OF / AT LAST, SUM, sort-order prerequisites

lessons.title: Secondary keys
points: Sorted/hashed secondary keys, USING KEY, key lazy update

lessons.title: Nested & deep tables
points: Tables inside structures, parallel cursor technique for nested loops

lessons.title: Modern table expressions
points: itab[ key = val ], line_exists( ), line_index( ), lines( )
VALUE #( ), FOR ... IN, REDUCE, FILTER, CORRESPONDING #( ), LOOP AT ... GROUP BY

lessons.title: Ranges
points: RANGES / TYPE RANGE OF, SIGN / OPTION / LOW / HIGH, use in WHERE

lessons.title: SELECT basics
points: SELECT SINGLE, SELECT ... UP TO n ROWS, SELECT ... ENDSELECT (and why to avoid it)
INTO TABLE, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF, APPENDING TABLE

lessons.title: WHERE conditions
points: =, IN (ranges/select-options), LIKE, BETWEEN, IS NULL, ORDER BY, DISTINCT

lessons.title: Joins & subqueries
points: INNER JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, joining on multiple keys, subqueries with EXISTS / IN

lessons.title: FOR ALL ENTRIES
points: Empty driver table check, duplicate removal, key completeness

lessons.title: Aggregates
points: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, GROUP BY, HAVING

lessons.title: DML statements
points: INSERT, UPDATE, MODIFY, DELETE on DB tables; SY-SUBRC & SY-DBCNT

lessons.title: Transactions & LUW
points: COMMIT WORK, ROLLBACK WORK, DB LUW vs SAP LUW
Update function modules (CALL FUNCTION ... IN UPDATE TASK), PERFORM ... ON COMMIT

lessons.title: New ABAP SQL syntax (7.40+)
points: Comma-separated fields, @ host variables, inline @DATA( ), CASE, COALESCE, string/arith functions
UNION, CTEs (WITH), window functions in newer releases

lessons.title: Native & dynamic SQL
points: Dynamic WHERE / field lists, EXEC SQL, ADBC (cl_sql_statement)

lessons.title: Database cursor
points: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH NEXT CURSOR ... PACKAGE SIZE, CLOSE CURSOR

lessons.title: Includes
points: Top include, selection-screen include, forms include; include vs program

lessons.title: Macros
points: DEFINE ... END-OF-DEFINITION, limitations, why to avoid in new code

lessons.title: Subroutines
points: FORM / PERFORM, USING, CHANGING, TABLES; pass by value vs reference
External perform, obsolete status in modern ABAP

lessons.title: Function modules
points: Function groups (SE80/SE37), global data in function groups
Import, export, changing, tables, exceptions; RAISE / MESSAGE ... RAISING
Normal vs remote-enabled vs update function modules
Calling: CALL FUNCTION, EXCEPTIONS, STARTING NEW TASK (asynchronous), IN BACKGROUND TASK

lessons.title: Methods
points: Local vs global class methods (see OOP section) as the modern default

lessons.title: Program calls
points: SUBMIT ... AND RETURN / VIA SELECTION-SCREEN / WITH, CALL TRANSACTION, LEAVE TO TRANSACTION

lessons.title: Selection screens
points: PARAMETERS, SELECT-OPTIONS, SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF BLOCK / LINE, radio buttons, checkboxes, list boxes
OBLIGATORY, DEFAULT, NO INTERVALS, NO-EXTENSION, MODIF ID, MATCHCODE OBJECT
Variants, text elements (selection texts, text symbols), F4 help for custom fields

lessons.title: Report events
points: LOAD-OF-PROGRAM, INITIALIZATION, AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT, AT SELECTION-SCREEN ON <field> / ON VALUE-REQUEST / ON HELP-REQUEST
START-OF-SELECTION, END-OF-SELECTION, TOP-OF-PAGE, END-OF-PAGE

lessons.title: Classical reports
points: WRITE, ULINE, SKIP, NEW-PAGE, FORMAT COLOR / INTENSIFIED / HOTSPOT, LINE-SIZE, LINE-COUNT

lessons.title: Interactive reports
points: AT LINE-SELECTION, AT USER-COMMAND, AT PFnn, HIDE, GET CURSOR, READ LINE, SY-LSIND (up to 20 secondary lists)
TOP-OF-PAGE DURING LINE-SELECTION, GUI status for lists (SE41)

lessons.title: ALV — function module based
points: REUSE_ALV_GRID_DISPLAY, REUSE_ALV_LIST_DISPLAY, field catalog, layout, sort, events, top-of-page
Hierarchical & blocked ALV

lessons.title: ALV — OO
points: CL_GUI_ALV_GRID with custom container: field catalog, toolbar, HANDLE_USER_COMMAND, DOUBLE_CLICK, HOTSPOT_CLICK, editable ALV, DATA_CHANGED
CL_SALV_TABLE (SALV): functions, columns, sorts, aggregations, events, popups
CL_SALV_TREE, CL_SALV_HIERSEQ_TABLE

lessons.title: Background processing
points: SM36/SM37, JOB_OPEN / JOB_SUBMIT / JOB_CLOSE, SY-BATCH, spool output (SP01)

lessons.title: Logical databases (legacy)
points: LDB concept, GET events, NODES — read only for legacy support (e.g. HR PNP/PNPCE)

lessons.title: Basics
points: Module pool program (type M), transaction code (SE93), screen numbers, screen flow

lessons.title: Screen Painter (SE51)
points: Layout editor, element list, attributes, flow logic
Screen elements: input/output fields, text fields, push buttons, radio buttons, checkboxes, frames, subscreen areas, custom controls

lessons.title: Flow logic events
points: PROCESS BEFORE OUTPUT (PBO), PROCESS AFTER INPUT (PAI), PROCESS ON VALUE-REQUEST (POV), PROCESS ON HELP-REQUEST (POH)
MODULE, FIELD ... MODULE, CHAIN ... ENDCHAIN, ON INPUT / ON REQUEST, AT EXIT-COMMAND

lessons.title: GUI status & title (SE41)
points: Function codes, SET PF-STATUS, SET TITLEBAR, OK_CODE handling, function types (E for exit)

lessons.title: Screen navigation
points: CALL SCREEN, SET SCREEN, LEAVE SCREEN, LEAVE TO SCREEN, modal dialog boxes (STARTING AT)

lessons.title: Dynamic screen modification
points: LOOP AT SCREEN, SCREEN-INPUT / ACTIVE / INVISIBLE / REQUIRED, MODIFY SCREEN, screen groups

lessons.title: Table control & step loops
points: CONTROLS ... TYPE TABLEVIEW, LOOP AT itab WITH CONTROL, scrolling, line selection, insert/delete rows

lessons.title: Tabstrip control
points: Tabstrips with subscreens, scrolling at application server vs SAPGUI

lessons.title: Subscreens
points: CALL SUBSCREEN, INCLUDING, subscreen data transfer

lessons.title: Controls framework
points: Custom container, docking/splitter containers, text editor, picture control, tree control, HTML viewer

lessons.title: Validations & locking
points: Field validations, error messages in PAI, lock objects in dialog transactions

lessons.title: OOP concepts
points: Class, object, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction

lessons.title: Local & global classes
points: CLASS ... DEFINITION / IMPLEMENTATION, SE24 class builder, DEFERRED, LOAD
Visibility sections: PUBLIC, PROTECTED, PRIVATE; friends

lessons.title: Attributes & methods
points: Instance vs static (CLASS-DATA, CLASS-METHODS), constants, read-only attributes
Parameters: importing, exporting, changing, returning; OPTIONAL, DEFAULT, functional methods

lessons.title: Constructors
points: Instance CONSTRUCTOR, CLASS_CONSTRUCTOR, order of execution, NEW #( ) vs CREATE OBJECT

lessons.title: Inheritance
points: INHERITING FROM, REDEFINITION, super->, FINAL, ABSTRACT classes/methods

lessons.title: Interfaces
points: INTERFACES, alias names, interface methods, compound interfaces

lessons.title: Polymorphism & casting
points: Up-cast (narrowing) and down-cast (widening) with ?= / CAST #( ), IS INSTANCE OF, CASE TYPE OF

lessons.title: Events
points: EVENTS, RAISE EVENT, SET HANDLER, instance vs static events

lessons.title: Object instantiation control
points: CREATE PRIVATE / PROTECTED / PUBLIC, singleton pattern, factory methods

lessons.title: Design patterns in ABAP
points: Singleton, factory, MVC, observer, strategy, decorator, persistence layer

lessons.title: Persistent & transaction services
points: Persistent classes, object services, CL_OS_SYSTEM

lessons.title: RTTS (Run Time Type Services)
points: RTTI: CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR; RTTC: dynamic structure/table creation

lessons.title: Clean ABAP & SOLID
points: SAP Clean ABAP style guide, SOLID principles, dependency injection

lessons.title: Classical exceptions
points: SY-SUBRC checks, function module EXCEPTIONS, CATCH SYSTEM-EXCEPTIONS (obsolete)

lessons.title: Class-based exceptions
points: TRY / CATCH / CLEANUP / ENDTRY, RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE, RETRY, RESUME
Exception classes: CX_STATIC_CHECK, CX_DYNAMIC_CHECK, CX_NO_CHECK; exception texts via message class/OTR

lessons.title: Debugger
points: /h, breakpoints (session, external, BREAK-POINT, BREAK <user>), watchpoints
Step F5/F6/F7/F8, changing variable values, table/structure view, call stack
Debugging update tasks, background jobs (JDBG / SM50), popups (debug via shortcut file), system debugging

lessons.title: Runtime analysis & logs
points: ST22 (short dumps), SM21 (system log), SLG1 / SLG0 (application log via BAL_* FMs)
Checkpoint groups (SAAB): ASSERT, LOG-POINT

lessons.title: Static checks
points: Extended program check (SLIN), Code Inspector (SCI), ATC

lessons.title: Unit testing
points: ABAP Unit: test classes FOR TESTING, RISK LEVEL, DURATION, cl_abap_unit_assert, setup/teardown
Test doubles: test seams, cl_abap_testdouble, OSQL test environment, CDS test environment

lessons.title: SAPscript
points: SE71 form painter: pages, windows (main, variable, constant), page windows, paragraph & character formats
Print program: OPEN_FORM, START_FORM, WRITE_FORM, END_FORM, CLOSE_FORM
Standard texts (SO10), INCLUDE, PERFORM in SAPscript, logo upload (SE78)

lessons.title: SmartForms
points: SMARTFORMS transaction: global settings, form interface, global definitions, initialization
Pages, windows, text nodes, tables, templates, loops, alternatives, commands, program lines
Styles (SMARTSTYLES), calling via SSF_FUNCTION_MODULE_NAME, control & output parameters
Converting to PDF: CONVERT_OTF, emailing with CL_BCS

lessons.title: Adobe Forms (SFP)
points: Interface (ABAP dictionary / XML), context, Adobe LiveCycle Designer layout
Print program: FP_JOB_OPEN, FP_FUNCTION_MODULE_NAME, FP_JOB_CLOSE; ADS configuration
FormCalc / JavaScript scripting, interactive forms, PDF output & email

lessons.title: Output management
points: NACE output types / condition records (ECC), BRF+ output management (S/4HANA)
Spool & printer setup (SPAD), SP01/SP02

lessons.title: File & email output
points: GUI_DOWNLOAD / GUI_UPLOAD, OPEN DATASET (application server, AL11), Excel export, CL_BCS email with attachments

lessons.title: Enhancement concept
points: Why enhance not modify; modification assistant (SPAU/SPDD) and access keys

lessons.title: User exits
points: Form-based exits (e.g. MV45AFZZ in SD), finding them via includes

lessons.title: Customer exits
points: SMOD / CMOD projects; function exits (CALL CUSTOMER-FUNCTION), screen exits, menu exits

lessons.title: BAdIs
points: Classic BAdI (SE18/SE19, CL_EXITHANDLER), kernel/new BAdI (GET BADI, CALL BADI)
Single vs multiple use, filter-dependent BAdIs, fallback class

lessons.title: Enhancement Framework
points: Implicit enhancement points (start/end of FM, form, method), explicit enhancement points & sections
Enhancement spots and composite enhancement spots

lessons.title: Class/FM enhancements
points: Pre-, post- and overwrite methods, additional parameters

lessons.title: Business Transaction Events (BTE)
points: FIBF, P&S vs process interfaces (mainly FI)

lessons.title: Validations & substitutions
points: GGB0 / GGB1 (FI/CO)

lessons.title: Finding enhancements
points: Techniques: CL_EXITHANDLER breakpoint, SE84, package search, ST05 trace, “find BAdI” reports

lessons.title: Key S/4HANA extensibility
points: Key user extensibility (custom fields & logic), developer extensibility, side-by-side on BTP

lessons.title: File handling
points: Presentation server (GUI_UPLOAD, cl_gui_frontend_services), application server (OPEN / READ / TRANSFER / CLOSE DATASET), Excel upload (TEXT_CONVERT_XLS_TO_SAP, ALSM_EXCEL_TO_INTERNAL_TABLE)

lessons.title: BDC (Batch Data Communication)
points: Recording (SHDB), BDCDATA structure
Call transaction method (modes A/E/N, update S/A/L, MESSAGES INTO), session method (BDC_OPEN_GROUP / INSERT / CLOSE, SM35)
Table control handling in BDC, CTU_PARAMS

lessons.title: LSMW
points: 14 steps, recording / batch input / BAPI / IDoc methods (legacy in S/4)

lessons.title: S/4HANA Migration Cockpit
points: LTMC / Migrate Your Data app, staging tables, migration objects

lessons.title: BAPI
points: BOR (SWO1), finding BAPIs (BAPI transaction), BAPIRET2 return handling
BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT / ROLLBACK, extension structures (EXTENSIONIN), custom BAPI creation

lessons.title: RFC
points: Remote-enabled FMs, RFC destinations (SM59), sRFC, aRFC, tRFC, qRFC, bgRFC

lessons.title: ALE & IDocs
points: IDoc structure: control, data, status records; basic types, extensions, message types
WE30, WE31, WE81, WE82, WE20 partner profiles, BD64 distribution model, WE02/WE05, BD87
Inbound/outbound process codes, custom IDoc FMs, change pointers (BD50, BD52, BD21)

lessons.title: Web services & APIs
points: SOAP services (SE80 / SOAMANAGER), REST via CL_HTTP_CLIENT, JSON (/ui2/cl_json, xco_cp_json)
OData with SAP Gateway: SEGW, DPC_EXT / MPC_EXT, CRUD-Q methods, $expand, deep insert, /IWFND/MAINT_SERVICE, /IWFND/GW_CLIENT

lessons.title: XML & transformations
points: CALL TRANSFORMATION, XSLT & Simple Transformations (STRANS), iXML library

lessons.title: Workflow basics
points: SWDD workflow builder, business objects, events, agents, SWI1 / SWEL

lessons.title: Analysis tools
points: ST05 (SQL / buffer / RFC trace), SAT / SE30 (runtime analysis), ST12, SQLM, SWLT, STAD, ST04

lessons.title: Database access rules
points: Select only needed fields (no SELECT *), use full/primary keys and indexes, avoid SELECT in LOOP
Use joins or FOR ALL ENTRIES correctly, aggregate in DB, use UP TO n ROWS, avoid nested SELECTs
Table buffering and BYPASSING BUFFER

lessons.title: Internal table rules
points: Sorted/hashed tables for lookups, BINARY SEARCH, field symbols over work areas, avoid nested loops (parallel cursor)
DELETE ... WHERE instead of loop + delete, FREE large tables

lessons.title: Code pushdown (HANA)
points: Move logic to DB via CDS / AMDP, avoid data-to-code transfer

lessons.title: Parallel processing
points: CALL FUNCTION ... STARTING NEW TASK with server groups (RZ12), SPTA framework, background packaging

lessons.title: Memory management
points: Memory Inspector (S_MEMORY_INSPECTOR), shared objects (SHMA), sharing vs copying of tables

lessons.title: New syntax (7.40+)
points: Inline declarations DATA( ), FIELD-SYMBOL( )
Constructor operators: NEW, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, CONV, CAST, REF, EXACT, COND, SWITCH, REDUCE, FILTER
Table expressions, FOR iterations, LET, BASE, string templates with formatting options
Predicate functions, xsdbool( ), boolc( )

lessons.title: ABAP CDS views
points: DDIC-based (DEFINE VIEW) vs CDS view entities (DEFINE VIEW ENTITY)
Joins, associations & path expressions, CASE, CAST, built-in functions, aggregates
Parameters, session variables, annotations (@AbapCatalog, @UI, @OData.publish, @Analytics)
Access control (DCL, @AccessControl.authorizationCheck), table functions
VDM layers: basic / interface (I_), composite, consumption (C_)

lessons.title: AMDP
points: IF_AMDP_MARKER_HDB, BY DATABASE PROCEDURE / FUNCTION, SQLScript basics, debugging AMDP

lessons.title: RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model)
points: Data model (CDS), behavior definition (BDEF), behavior pool, service definition & binding
Managed vs unmanaged, draft handling, determinations, validations, actions, feature control
EML: READ ENTITIES, MODIFY ENTITIES, COMMIT ENTITIES
Fiori Elements preview, metadata extensions

lessons.title: ABAP Cloud & clean core
points: ABAP Cloud language version, released APIs (C1 contract), BTP ABAP Environment, embedded Steampunk
Tier model (Tier 1/2/3), ATC cloud readiness checks

lessons.title: S/4HANA data model changes
points: MATDOC, ACDOCA, Business Partner (BP) replacing customer/vendor, simplified tables, compatibility views

lessons.title: Tooling
points: Eclipse ADT (mandatory for CDS/RAP), abapGit, ABAP Doc, quick fixes & refactoring
